name: Seagull Sim
source:
Did you ever dream of finding the love of your life? Or maybe... The SEAGULL of your life? Dive into this incredibly realistic (no), difficult (no), and hilarious (yes) game where you'll try to find your seagull soulmate!

Discover Kitty, Rose, and Blackback, our three main protagonists, through a hilarious speed-dating experience on the "Fish & Ships" ship of shipping chip lovers!

[From [url=https://edrakan.itch.io/seagullsim]Itch.io[/url]]
